purpose: They define when the system creates an alert (debt, inactive patient, unconfirmed appointment) and whether it's sent automatically by email or WhatsApp.
tips: A rule with automatic sending messages patients: review it carefully before activating it.

system.alert-rules.field.category_id.label: Category
system.alert-rules.field.category_id.description: Where it shows in the Alerts Center.

system.alert-rules.field.source_table.label: Source
system.alert-rules.field.source_table.description: Where the cases come from (appointments, invoices, patients…).

system.alert-rules.field.event_field.label: Event date
system.alert-rules.field.event_field.description: The date the days are counted from.

system.alert-rules.field.auto_send_email.label: Send email automatically
system.alert-rules.field.auto_send_email.description: If checked, the email goes out on its own when the alert is created.
